label: Episode 22
logline: Disguised as a common scullery maid, Lady Juliana infiltrates Ashbury Manor alongside Prudence and slips into the forbidden West Wing, where she discovers the dying Dowager Duchess suffering from an unnatural, poisoned affliction.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 21 where Prudence revealed that the Dowager Duchess is dying from a mysterious illness; Juliana sets aside her aristocratic identity to sneak into Ashbury Manor under the guise of domestic help to save her.

[01:36.00-01:38.50] ACTION: Prudence rushes into frame, grabbing Juliana's arm to keep her moving.
[01:36.00-01:38.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence whispering frantically into Juliana's ear.
[01:36.00-01:38.50] PRUDENCE (Panicked, Hushed): "Do not stare. Keep walking."
[01:38.80-01:42.00] CAMERA: Wide tracking shot behind Lady Juliana as she hastens down the long marble gallery toward the secluded West Wing wing.
[01:42.00-01:45.50] CAMERA: Medium shot of Lady Juliana standing outside a massive carved mahogany door, glancing around the empty hallway to ensure she is unobserved.
[01:45.50-01:48.50] ACTION: Lady Juliana reaches out with a trembling hand and quietly turns the ornate brass and glass door knob.
[01:45.50-01:48.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana's hand twisting the latch handle.
[01:46.50-01:48.50] SOUND: Faint, muffled click of the heavy door lock turning.
[01:48.50-01:53.80] CAMERA: Slow tracking shot into the cavernous, shadowy bedchamber. In the center stands an ornate four-poster canopy bed draped in pale silk where a frail, silver-haired figure lies motionless.
[01:49.00-01:54.00] SOUND: Labored, raspy, shallow breathing echoing in the quiet room.
[01:53.80-01:56.00] ACTION: Lady Juliana hurries inside, sets the wooden bucket onto the floor, and rushes to the bedside.
[01:54.00-01:55.50] LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Concerned): "Your Grace?"
[01:55.50-01:58.20] CAMERA: Close-up of the Dowager Duchess lying propped on pillows, her face gaunt, ashen, and drenched in cold sweat, her eyes half-fluttering.
[01:58.20-02:00.80] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Lady Juliana taking the Duchess's fragile, cold hands into her own.
[01:58.20-01:59.80] LADY JULIANA (Soft, Comforting): "Do not speak."
[02:00.80-02:05.50] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana checking the Duchess's pulse and gently pressing her fingertips against the Duchess's chest and neck, her herbalist instincts taking over.
[02:03.00-02:05.80] ACTION: Lady Juliana's eyes widen with sudden, horrifying realization.
[02:03.50-02:05.80] LADY JULIANA (Shocked, Murmuring): "This isn't ordinary fever."
[02:05.80-02:07.00] ACTION: The Dowager Duchess suddenly gasps violently for breath, convulsing weakly as her eyes snap open in agony.
[02:05.80-02:07.00] CAMERA: Close-up of the Duchess gasping in sudden spasms.
[02:07.00-02:08.80] CAMERA: Intense two-shot as Lady Juliana leans in close, gripping the Duchess's shoulder with urgent desperation.
[02:07.20-02:08.80] LADY JULIANA (Urgent, Alarmed): "Who has been treating you?"
[02:08.80-02:11.00] CAMERA: Extreme close-up on the Dowager Duchess's terrified, wide eyes staring up as she chokes for air, the haunting realization of poison lingering as dramatic music hits an abrupt, suspenseful cliffhanger.

CLIP: episode 22, 1 segment(s), 59s
[00:11.20-00:14.20] LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Quiet): "No one will recognize me dressed like this."
[00:14.20-00:19.00] CAMERA: Medium close-up of Prudence glancing nervously toward the courtyard before fixing her gaze on Juliana.
[00:14.20-00:19.00] PRUDENCE (Nervous, Warning): "This is Ashburton Manor. The housekeeper watches everyone. Lady Catherine watches everyone, and Lord Rupert..."
[00:19.00-00:21.20] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana cutting in with fierce, unyielding conviction.
[00:19.10-00:21.00] LADY JULIANA (Determined): "The Duchess is dying."
[00:21.20-00:25.80] CAMERA: Low-angle shot looking up at Lady Juliana and Prudence standing beneath the looming stone facade of the manor.
[00:22.00-00:25.50] LADY JULIANA (Defiant, Firm): "I saved Toby. I can save her."
[00:25.80-00:28.10] CAMERA: Close-up on Prudence, her eyes wide with dread.
[00:26.00-00:28.10] PRUDENCE (Fretful): "And if they discover who you are?"
[00:28.10-00:31.50] CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana holding her gaze steadily.
[00:28.20-00:31.00] LADY JULIANA (Steely, Selfless): "Then I will face that when she is breathing again."
[00:31.50-00:36.20] CAMERA: Medium two-shot outside the heavy wooden servant entrance door.
[00:33.80-00:36.00] PRUDENCE (Solemn): "Then forget you were ever a lady."
[00:36.20-00:39.80] CAMERA: Close-up of Lady Juliana swallowing her pride and accepting her perilous disguise.
[00:37.00-00:39.50] LADY JULIANA (Quietly Resolute): "Today, I am only a maid."
[00:39.80-00:42.50] ACTION: Prudence opens the heavy wooden service door, and both women step inside into the dark servants' corridor as the door shuts firmly behind them.
[00:41.50-00:42.80] SOUND: Heavy wooden latch clicks shut with a thud.
[00:43.00-00:44.20] HOUSEKEEPER (Sharp, Stern, O.S.): "Prudence."
[00:43.00-00:46.00] CAMERA: Medium shot of the formidable Housekeeper standing in the dim stone hallway with arms folded, ring of keys dangling from her waist.
[00:44.30-00:45.60] HOUSEKEEPER (Suspicious): "Who is this?"
[00:46.00-00:49.20] CAMERA: Medium shot of Prudence curtsying low with downcast eyes while Lady Juliana stands behind her carrying a heavy wooden water bucket.
[00:46.00-00:49.00] PRUDENCE (Submissive): "Julian, ma'am. New help for the winter cleaning."
[00:49.20-00:52.20] CAMERA: Close-up profile of the Housekeeper sizing up Juliana critically.
[00:49.50-00:51.80] HOUSEKEEPER (Cold, Skeptical): "She looks soft."
[00:51.80-00:53.00] ACTION: Close-up on Lady Juliana's hands gripping the iron handle of the wooden wash bucket firmly.
[00:52.80-00:55.20] CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana keeping her eyes dutifully lowered.
[00:52.80-00:54.80] LADY JULIANA (Humble, Steady): "I can work, ma'am."
[00:55.20-00:58.50] CAMERA: Low-angle shot of the Housekeeper staring down coldly.
[00:56.00-00:58.00] HOUSEKEEPER (Demanding): "Can you scrub stone?"
[00:58.50-01:00.00] CAMERA: Close-up on Lady Juliana nodding slightly.
[00:58.50-00:59.80] LADY JULIANA (Subdued): "Yes, ma'am."
[01:00.20-01:01.80] HOUSEKEEPER (Harsh, O.S.): "Carry coal?"
[01:00.20-01:02.30] CAMERA: Close-up of the Housekeeper's stern face.
[01:02.30-01:04.20] CAMERA: Cut back to Lady Juliana maintaining her meek posture.
[01:02.50-01:03.80] LADY JULIANA (Polite): "Yes, ma'am."
[01:04.20-01:09.75] CAMERA: Profile medium two-shot as the Housekeeper steps right up into Lady Juliana's face, staring intently into her downcast eyes.
[01:06.00-01:09.50] HOUSEKEEPER (Menacing, Threatening): "And can you keep your eyes and ears where they belong?"
